# Simple Count

> Simple Count (App Store name: "Simple Countdown Widget App") is a free countdown app for iPhone and iPad with Home Screen widgets, Lock Screen widgets, Live Activities and Dynamic Island. No subscription, no ads, no account. Every widget is included for free. Simple Count Pro is an optional one-time purchase.

- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6761277550
- Website: https://simplecountdownapp.github.io/
- Developer: Caner Tasan (independent developer)
- Platforms: iPhone and iPad, iOS / iPadOS 17.6 or later
- Languages: English, Dutch, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Turkish, Japanese, Korean, Chinese (Simplified)
- Privacy: App Store privacy label "Data Not Collected"; no account, data stays on the device and in the user's own iCloud

## Free

- Unlimited countdowns for trips, birthdays, weddings, concerts, holidays, exams and anything else
- Home Screen widgets in every size (a full-page widget on iOS 27), Lock Screen widgets, Live Activities and Dynamic Island
- A "Next Event" widget that always shows the closest countdown and moves on by itself
- Exact-time countdowns (days, hours, minutes, seconds) and days-since for past events
- Repeating countdowns: daily, weekly, monthly, yearly, or patterns like the third Sunday of each month
- Reminders days, hours or minutes before each event
- Notes with sections and checklists
- iPhone and iPad sync through the user's own iCloud
- Count Down Together: share a countdown by invite link and it stays in sync for everyone (one shared countdown at a time free; joining always free)
- Siri ("Add a countdown in Simple Count", "How many days until …") and import from Calendar
- No ads, no subscription

## Simple Count Pro (one-time purchase)

- $4.99 in the US, €5.99 in the euro area, £4.99 in the UK (prices vary by country)
- Photo backgrounds on countdown cards and widgets
- Photos and files in notes
- Unlimited shared countdowns
